info.headline: Severe Cyclonic Storm Advisory for Maharashtra-Goa Maritime Belt
info.description: Severe cyclonic disturbance active over North-Central Arabian Sea. Gale force winds reaching 45-55 knots with very rough sea state. Total suspension of all artisanal and motorized fishing operations advised.
info.instruction: All fishermen are advised not to venture into deep sea and coastal waters of Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, and South Konkan.
